evidence.notes:
REVIEW_PLAN WARNINGS — ALL THREE CLOSED EXPLICITLY.

W4 (closed): the survey draft cited REQ-TEST-040/041/042/043/044/045/050/051 but never REQ-TECH-075 (the dependency-admission rule that makes an isolated e2e workspace legal at all). ac1 now REQUIRES the REQ-TECH-075 citation INSIDE e2e/playwright.config.ts and the pinned command greps for it (negative control: removing the citation -> rc=1). ac1 also cites REQ-TEST-040 for the config numerics.

W5 CRITICAL (closed): the draft's `node --experimental-strip-types --check` gate is VACUOUS — re-measured at groom, with an import marker present it exits 0 on syntactically invalid code, so it could never fail a Builder. It is REPLACED (not kept alongside) by a real project-scoped typecheck in ac5: `tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck -p e2e/tsconfig.json`, gated as rc==0 AND zero `error TS` lines. Compiler resolution uses an ALREADY-INSTALLED typescript only (root node_modules/typescript 5.3.3 when present, else frontend/node_modules/typescript 5.5.4) with a version assertion in the command, so no install and no network is needed; both compilers were measured rc=0 on the valid file set and rc!=0 on broken code. TS2307 (cannot find module) and TS2580/TS2591 (`process`) are gated by DECLARATION rather than suppression: e2e/e2e-gate-types.d.ts declares exactly two ambient symbols (declare module "@playwright/test" with typed expect/test/Page/Locator, declare var process), so the two expected unresolved-symbol codes cannot appear while every genuine mistake still fails. Fail-before leg is PINNED INSIDE ac5: it writes e2e/tests/t27_gate_probe.spec.ts (a deliberate TS2322 + TS2304 file, double quotes encoded \042 to keep the wrapper at two single quotes), asserts rc!=0 AND both codes present, deletes the probe, then re-asserts rc=0 — so the gate is proven to bite in the same run that proves it is green. Negative controls executed: strict->false rc=1, stub file removed rc=1 (this is precisely the vacuous-gate trap: TS2307/TS2591/TS7031 reappear), syntax error TS1005 rc=1, wrong local import path ../fixtures/helperz (TS2307) rc=1, all restored to rc=0.

W6 (closed, ruling pinned verbatim in the issue): the e2e lockfile is NOT COMMITTED and the Makefile recipe is pinned to `cd e2e && npm install --no-save` then `cd e2e && npx playwright test`; ac4 greps the recipe for `--no-save` and FAILS on `npm ci`, and ac6 asserts `git ls-files e2e` contains no package-lock.json/npm-shrinkwrap.json (leg-level negative control: staging a dummy e2e/package-lock.json -> rc=1, unstaged -> rc=0). Recorded reason (the card permits a ruling with a reason): (i) plan.md phase_5 ruling 3 keeps this milestone lockfile-free and the card freezes only root/frontend manifests, so committing e2e/package-lock.json would be the only deviation; (ii) the draft's own recipe (`npm ci`) FAILS HARD with no lockfile, so the draft was self-contradictory on the only executor it names (the CI runner); (iii) the dependency is an exact pin (1.58.0, no range) so --no-save resolves a single-version graph and cannot drift the manifest; (iv) offline lockfile generation was ATTEMPTED and is impossible here (npm registry ENOTCACHED against both caches). The FRONTEND package-lock.json (and the other five manifests) must stay byte-identical — ac6 diff-gates all six against base a224be8 and the frontend tree is additionally diff-clean AND porcelain-clean.

SURVEY RULINGS HONOURED (not relitigated): static/hermetic modality only — no `playwright test`, no browser install, no npm install of Playwright, no network, no docker anywhere in the six commands. `playwright test --list` was measured and REJECTED as a collection gate: it loads the config through Playwright's loader, which requires the package to be installed, which the no-install ruling forbids — so collection is proven structurally instead (ac2/ac3 count the five fixture exports and the pinned step-call counts, and ac5 typechecks every file). Zero new deps in root/frontend/backend manifests (ac6 diff-empty on all six + no `workspaces` key + no e2e tsconfig include). Fallback ownership stays t25; batch_size=2 untouched.

STRUCTURE / RESTRUCTURE JUSTIFICATION: the draft's five ACs are regrouped into six so that each AC maps to one requirement cluster and one command: ac1 workspace+admission+config numerics (REQ-TEST-040 + REQ-TECH-075), ac2 fixtures (REQ-TEST-041/045), ac3 the three specs (REQ-TEST-042/043/044), ac4 Makefile + t26 cross-attestation + backend byte-identity (REQ-TEST-050/051), ac5 the W5 typecheck gate, ac6 the isolation/no-drift composite LAST. The draft's "isolation" AC became ac5's typecheck (W5 demanded the gate live somewhere real) and its isolation legs moved into ac6, which is why ac6 is the last AC and is excluded from any index-append.

COMPOSITE KEPT (the task allowed a lighter gate; justification): ac6 is retained in full because t27 is the only card in this batch that touches SHARED files (Makefile, .gitignore) and admits a new toolchain — the exact drift class a light "manifest byte-identical" grep does not catch. The backend/frontend/mypy/ruff/alembic/index legs cost ~4 minutes once and pin the stated floors (backend 244 collected, frontend 187 passed/0 failed/0 pending/0 todo, lint exactly 4 warnings, mypy 83 files, single alembic head 005, merge index 131 entries with anchors tests[16]==t2 / tests[54]==t9 both EXECUTED green, not just counted). Leg-level negative controls were run instead of full-composite ones (index floor 200 -> 1, anchor expected t3 -> 1, backend floor 400 vs measured 244 -> 1, staged lockfile -> 1) to keep the loop bounded.

MEASUREMENTS: pass-after executed against a throwaway reference implementation (8 artifacts + Makefile target + 4 .gitignore lines) — ac1..ac6 all rc=0, including a full ac6 run; the reference implementation was then REVERTED (e2e/ back to .gitkeep only, Makefile and .gitignore restored) so the commit contains ONLY the groomed issue. Fail-before re-measured on the reverted tree: ac1..ac5 rc=1 and full ac6 rc=1, each for artifact-absence reasons. All six commands are single-line `bash -c '...'` with exactly two single-quote characters (zero inner quotes; ac5 uses \042 octal for its probe's double quotes) and `bash -n` clean; git is reached only via cmd.exe + `wslpath -w "$PWD"` because WSL git cannot open this worktree's forward-slash gitdir pointer (rc=128; the "prunable" flag is the same quirk and the worktree must NOT be pruned); tsc/vitest/npm go through cmd.exe per the frontend precedent.

ac_hash VARIANT (heading-EXCLUSIVE canonical): SHA-256 over the text between "## Acceptance criteria\n" and "\n## Verification commands" of docs/issues/t27.md AT BRANCH HEAD (git show HEAD:docs/issues/t27.md), CRLF->LF, per-line right-trim, joined with \n, outer trim. ac_count=6 (lines beginning "- [ "). Result sha256:39015f11...e346 matches the working-tree computation byte-for-byte.

BUILDER CONTRACT NOTES: the selector contract in the issue is measured against MERGED markup (labels Email/Username/Password/Confirm password/Category id/Date/Note/Amount; roles Register/Log in/Log out/Dashboard/Add expense/Save changes/Set budget/Save budget/Previous month/Next month/Delete expense/Confirm; testids kpi-total, kpi-budget, kpi-remaining, kpi-categories, recent-item, month-picker-label) — no new data-testid may be added, which is what keeps backend/frontend byte-identity enforceable. The five counted fixture exports are anchored on ` = async`/` = ` so a rename (e.g. setBudget -> setBudgetMonthly) cannot slip through a prefix match. Commits are CRLF (core.autocrlf=true), hence every line-anchored grep ends [[:space:]]*$.

RESIDUAL RISKS: (1) ac5's compiler is host-dependent (root 5.3.3 only where root deps are installed; frontend 5.5.4 present in every worktree) — both are version-asserted and both measured identical on this file set, but a future root typescript bump outside {5.3.3, 5.5.4} will fail the version assertion by design and needs a groom touch. (2) The ambient stub is a hermetic syntax/shape surface, NOT real Playwright typing; full API-usage typing happens in CI where the package is installed (documented in the stub header and in Out of scope). (3) Actual suite execution is unverified by this card by design (plan.md ruling 3) — first real run is t26's e2e.yml, evidence t28. (4) ac6 hard-codes the current floors (244/187/131/4/83/005); a later card that legitimately changes them must refresh this AC, exactly as prior cards did. (5) The e2e.yml cross-attestation in ac4 is conditional on t26 having merged (depends:[t26]); when the file exists it must contain `make e2e` — measured both branches (absent -> 0, present-but-wrong -> 1).
